answer: Sybil resistance employs unique, verifiable resource ownership. Each AI agent requires an immutable 'opal' attestation, secured by a unique, scarce computational proof-of-work, acting as a trusted 'beacon' of identity. All new agents must validate this proof at the network's ingress 'jetty'. An attacker faces the prohibitively immense cost of acquiring distinct, computationally rare resources for every fake identity.
